subject: Documentation about RPM macros?
text:
Hi,

Can someone tell me where I can find some
documentation about rpm macros?  In
particular, I'd like to understand the
'%files devel', '%post -p', and '%postun -p'
uses described at

and, more generally, I'm looking for a
more detailed description of the available
macros and the options they accept.  There's
no description of the above uses of %file,
%post, or %postun in the maximum-rpm book.

Thanks in advance for any help!
